2.note: The whole shape of this PR is decided by this sentence. `UniversalConnection` is thin: connect, encode a payload, write it. It could have been the entire package. But the device refuses a touch report unless a media stream is running, so something has to own a video stream nobody wants video from. That something is `Session`, which is why 523 of the 1,754 lines live in session.go.

claims.text: nothing in UniversalConnection gates touch on a media stream; the gate lives entirely in Session
claims.evidence: hid.go holds no stream reference, and ios/hid is the only importer of ios/display

60.note: Fire and forget ends at this return. Nothing reads a reply, so a nil error means the report was written, not that anything happened on screen. This is the contract most likely to be misread by a caller.
